writing.overall_comment: A solid, well-role-defined architect agent that would benefit from explicit task boundaries, a tighter output contract, and trimmed redundancy.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: Description names concrete triggers (架构设计、技术选型、ADR) but lacks explicit routing signals like task keywords or when-not-to-use guidance.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: Role, expertise, design process, and response patterns are explicit, though no strict output contract (format, file paths, length) is specified.

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: The prompt lists design anti-patterns but never states what the subagent must not do (e.g., avoid implementing code) or when to hand back to other agents.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: Content is reasonable but repetitive, with the skills section, design principles, and closing '记住' bullets overlapping heavily and inflating the token budget.

suggestions: In the prompt, add explicit 'must not' constraints (e.g., do not implement code) and handoff criteria for when to return to other agents, since the current prompt only lists design anti-patterns.
Consolidate the overlapping skills section, design principles, and closing '记住' bullets into one concise list to reduce repetition and token budget.
In the description, add explicit routing signals such as task keywords and when-not-to-use guidance to complement the existing concrete triggers (架构设计、技术选型、ADR).
